title: Transfer Pricing Documentation — Information Technology Sector
metaTitle: Transfer Pricing Documentation Overview | NRSR & Co
metaDesc: An overview of Transfer Pricing documentation prepared for a cross-border information technology entity.
summary: Transfer Pricing documentation, including Form 3CEB filing, was prepared for an entity with cross-border related-party transactions.
challenge: The entity, a subsidiary of an overseas parent, was required to document its cross-border related-party transactions in accordance with Transfer Pricing provisions under Section 92 of the Income Tax Act.
solution: The engagement covered a Function, Assets, and Risk (FAR) analysis, benchmarking of comparable transactions, and preparation of contemporaneous documentation under Rule 10D, along with certification in Form 3CEB.
execution: Documentation was compiled in coordination with the entity's finance team, with benchmarking carried out using authorized databases, followed by filing of Form 3CEB within the applicable due date.
